scene.description: Scene ID for a single-scene file

kind.description: Scene kind (6.9): normal (default), title, opening, ending, sub (subscene), system (system scene)

params.description: Subscene parameters (name -> default or {default, required, description})

menu.description: Menu (title / system scenes). Shown as a choice; shown again after the chosen item's steps

ending.description: Ending ID (kind: ending). Recorded as seen on entry

replay.description: Opening (kind: opening) from the second time: always (default), once (play only the first time), skippable (Esc skips, Ctrl fast-forwards)

next.description: Scene to go to when the opening is skipped or ends (title or entry when omitted)

bgm.description: BGM on entering (ID or {id, fade, loop, volume}; kept if the same; null stops)

bgm_fade.description: Fade seconds when bgm is null

variants.description: Background / BGM overrides on entry; matching entries are applied in order (later wins). E.g. change the title by endings seen (sys.endings_seen)

fin.description: The FIN screen after an ending (kind: ending) finishes (false hides it). Merged over the project fin

image.description: Background image ID (or path). An array overlays the entries whose when holds

image_transition.description: Transition when an image array changes (default cut)

enter.description: Steps on entering (after the first visit if first exists)

region.description: [x, y, width, height] in native pixels

sprite.description: Sprite ID whose visible area becomes the hotspot

click.description: Verb used on click (context and click methods)

character.description: Speaker ID when this is a character

on.description: Reaction per verb. "USE+door" narrows by the with target

objects.description: Objects and characters in the scene

on.description: Reaction per verb. "USE+door" narrows by the with target

region.description: [x, y, width, height] in native pixels

sprites.description: Sprites placed in the scene (shown while when holds)

on.description: Reaction per verb. "USE+door" narrows by the with target

aliases.description: Aliases (5.4). [alias=name args...] in text is replaced. Value is text or {params, text} ({arg.param} inside text)

intent_schema.description: Intent schema layer of this scenario

event_defaults.description: Overrides for output event defaults (wait, etc.)

wait.description: When to continue: none, click, end, input, or seconds

flow.description: Flowchart structure. Reaching a node is recorded with flow.mark

chapters.description: Chapters (node is a flowchart node; unlocked when reached)

condition.description: Condition (5.8). JSON form or short string form (e.g. "has_key and money >= 100")

step.description: Step. A string (narration or "@speaker text"), an array of steps, or a step object

set.description: Variable changes. A string value starting with "=" is an expression

anyOf.description: Line of dialogue with ID or voice

goto.description: Jump target (dialogue or scene). Does not return

call_scene.description: Subscene to call (kind: sub). Comes back on return

args.description: Arguments (name -> value; a string starting with "=" is evaluated by the caller). Read as arg.name inside the subscene

into.description: Variable that receives the return value

return.description: Return from the subscene. The value (a string starting with "=" is an expression) goes into the caller's into; null for none

wait.description: When to continue: none, click, end, input, or seconds

advance.description: Close on: click, key, key:name, seconds, trigger:name (default ["click", "key"])

min_time.description: Seconds before it can be closed (default 1)

then.description: After closing: title (default), new, quit, stay, or a scene ID

reset.description: Reset to the initial state before going to the then scene

items.description: Rows and images (same as credits items), centered instead of text

save_prompt.description: Ask to save clear data after closing (default false)

save_resume.description: Scene to start when clear data is loaded (default: entry)

save_carry.description: What clear data carries over: all (default), none, or {vars, items, visited, talked, notebook, chosen} (unlisted parts are not carried)

event_args.description: Arguments per output event (used by the editor form)

log.description: Also add to the message log (default: notice style)
